class.name: CbMotionEffect
class.brief_description: What a motion does to a body: the base of [CbImpulse], [CbForce] and [CbLink]. On whom, and in which direction.
class.description: Not a node to add: add a [CbImpulse], a [CbForce] or a [CbLink] under a [CbMotion]. A motion can have several, and they run in the order of the tree. Every effect has a [member target] (who it acts on) and a direction ([member frame]). The direction is always the acting player's own, whoever the effect acts on: "look" on another player pushes it where [i]you[/i] look. Bodies have weight. A player weighs its [code]mass[/code] movement parameter (80 kg unless a server, a character or a mod says otherwise); a prop, its shape's density. The world cannot be pushed.

members.member: With [constant TARGET_FIELD]: a field of the player that holds an entity's id ([code]bind.partner[/code]). The server mod declares it and writes into it; while it names nothing that exists, the effect does nothing.
With [constant FRAME_WORLD]: the direction, in the world. Its length does not matter.

constants.constant: The player whose motion it is.
What the motion's [CbProbe] found: a prop or a player, at the point it holds. The world takes nothing.
The entity [member target_field] names: another player, a prop.
Where the camera looks, pitch included.
Where the movement input points, relative to the camera; where the body faces when there is none. A dash.
From the player toward the target; for an effect on the player itself, toward what its [CbProbe] found. A pull.
